Footer.about_us_content: We are a leading provider of high-quality parquet flooring. With over 10 years of experience, we offer a wide range of wood types, finishes, and styles to suit any interior. Our mission is to bring elegance and durability to your home.
Footer.services_content: Our services include parquet installation, restoration, and maintenance. We also provide free consultations to help you choose the perfect flooring for your space. Let us transform your floors into works of art!
Footer.contact_content: For any inquiries, feel free to reach out to us via email or phone. Visit our store at 123 Main St, City, Country, or fill out the contact form on our website. We're here to help!
Footer.privacy_policy_content: We respect your privacy. Your personal information is securely stored and will never be shared with third parties without your consent. For more details, please read our full Privacy Policy.

PrivacyPolicy.intro_1: Effect Parquet ("we", "us", the "Company") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us through the website effectparquet.com (the "Site").
PrivacyPolicy.intro_2: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, with whom we share it, and the rights available to you. By using the Site you agree to the practices described in this policy.
PrivacyPolicy.collected_intro: Depending on how you use the Site, we may collect the following types of information:
PrivacyPolicy.collected_1: Contact details you provide, such as name, phone number, email address, and delivery address.
PrivacyPolicy.collected_2: Order and purchase information, including the products you select and the details of your inquiries.
PrivacyPolicy.collected_3: Content of messages you send us through contact and consultation forms.
PrivacyPolicy.collected_4: Technical data that is collected automatically, such as IP address, device type, and browser.
PrivacyPolicy.collected_5: Usage and interaction data about how you browse and use the Site.
PrivacyPolicy.methods_1: Directly from you when you fill in a form, place an order, or contact us.
PrivacyPolicy.methods_2: Automatically through cookies and similar technologies while you browse the Site.
PrivacyPolicy.methods_3: From third parties that provide us with services such as analytics, advertising, hosting, and content delivery.
PrivacyPolicy.use_1: To operate the Site and provide the products and services you request.
PrivacyPolicy.use_2: To process orders and inquiries and to contact you regarding them.
PrivacyPolicy.use_3: To improve the Site, our products, and the user experience.
PrivacyPolicy.use_4: To send updates, offers, and marketing content where you have agreed to receive them.
PrivacyPolicy.use_5: To maintain information security, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations.
PrivacyPolicy.sharing_intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with trusted service providers who help us operate the Site, including:
PrivacyPolicy.sharing_1: Analytics and advertising services such as Google Analytics and Meta (Facebook) Pixel.
PrivacyPolicy.sharing_2: Hosting and cloud storage providers used to run the Site and store images.
PrivacyPolicy.sharing_3: Mapping and reviews services such as Google, used to display location and customer reviews.
PrivacyPolicy.sharing_4: Delivery service providers, where relevant to completing your order.
PrivacyPolicy.sharing_5: Artificial-intelligence image-processing providers (currently OpenAI) that generate the room-visualizer preview from the photo you submit.
PrivacyPolicy.sharing_outro: We may also disclose information where required by law or to protect our legal rights.
PrivacyPolicy.cookies_1: The Site uses cookies and similar technologies for functionality, analytics, and marketing purposes.
PrivacyPolicy.cookies_2: You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings; note that some Site features may not function properly without them.
PrivacyPolicy.visualizer_1: The Site offers a feature that shows how a floor would look in your own room. To use it you may take or upload a photo of your room.
PrivacyPolicy.visualizer_2: The photo is transmitted over an encrypted connection to a third-party AI image-processing provider (currently OpenAI) solely to generate the preview. We do not store the photo or the generated image on our servers; they are held in memory only for the time needed to create and deliver the result, and are then discarded.
PrivacyPolicy.visualizer_3: We keep only technical statistics about each generation: the date and time, the selected product, whether the generation succeeded or failed, the error message if any, processing time, the amount of computation used, and the IP address of the request (for abuse prevention and daily limits). These records do not include the photo.
PrivacyPolicy.visualizer_4: The provider processes the photo under its own terms and privacy policy. According to OpenAI's API data-usage policy, data submitted through the API is not used to train its models and may be retained by the provider for a limited period (currently up to 30 days) for abuse monitoring. We do not control the provider's retention policies.
PrivacyPolicy.visualizer_5: Please do not upload photos that show people, faces, identity documents, or other sensitive personal information. Only submit photos you have the right to use. The generated image is an AI illustration and may differ from how the product looks in reality.
PrivacyPolicy.visualizer_6: Sample rooms offered in the visualizer are photos provided or generated by us and are not customer photos.
PrivacyPolicy.security_1: We apply reasonable and accepted measures to protect the confidentiality and security of your information.
PrivacyPolicy.security_2: However, no system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute protection against unauthorized access.
PrivacyPolicy.rights_intro: Subject to applicable law, you may:
PrivacyPolicy.rights_1: Request to view the personal information we hold about you.
PrivacyPolicy.rights_2: Request to correct or update inaccurate information.
PrivacyPolicy.rights_3: Request the deletion of your personal information.
PrivacyPolicy.rights_4: Object to the use of your information for marketing purposes.
PrivacyPolicy.updates_1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The date of the latest update appears at the bottom of this page.
PrivacyPolicy.contact_text: For any question or request regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, contact us by email at effectparquet@gmail.com or by phone at 058-44-55-478.

Accessibility.intro_1: Effect Parquet sees great importance in providing its services to all, including people with disabilities, and acts to make its website accessible so that any person can browse it conveniently, equally, and independently.
Accessibility.intro_2: We invest significant resources to make the Site as accessible as possible, out of the belief that every person deserves an equal opportunity to use the digital space.
Accessibility.standard_1: The Site strives to comply with the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations (Service Accessibility Adjustments), 2013, and with Israeli Standard TI 5568 at the AA level.
Accessibility.standard_2: The accessibility adjustments are based on the WCAG 2.0 (and where possible 2.1) guidelines of the W3C.
Accessibility.features_intro: The Site includes an accessibility tool that allows visitors to adjust the display to their needs, including:
Accessibility.features_1: Adjusting font size and text spacing.
Accessibility.features_3: Compatibility with screen readers (such as NVDA and JAWS).
Accessibility.features_4: High-contrast and inverted color display modes.
Accessibility.features_6: Semantic structure that supports assistive technologies.
Accessibility.how_to_use_title: How to Use the Accessibility Tool
Accessibility.how_to_use_1: The accessibility menu can be opened using the accessibility icon displayed on the Site. Selecting an option applies the relevant adjustment immediately; the settings can be reset at any time.
Accessibility.limitations_1: We continue to improve the accessibility of the Site as part of our commitment to the public. Despite our efforts, some pages or content may not yet be fully accessible. If you encounter an accessibility issue, we would be grateful if you let us know and we will work to resolve it.
Accessibility.physical_1: Our store is located at Herzl 110, Rishon LeZion. For information about physical accessibility arrangements at the branch, please contact us using the details below.
Accessibility.contact_text: Our accessibility coordinator is Ruslan. If you encountered an accessibility problem or have a request or suggestion for improvement, please contact him by email at effectparquet@gmail.com or by phone at 058-44-55-478, and we will respond as soon as possible.
